Tess R (CS): quick sync for LakeGate private/VPC onboarding. Summary: app subnets can't egress to our collectors, KMS key hasn't allowed our service role, and Splunk shows no audit events. compliance review Fri. owners + ETAs?
Ibrahim N (Network): i'll take egress. looks like app route table only points to TGW with no NAT in the AZs they chose. need either per-AZ NAT or an egress appliance. LakeGate PM, can you confirm preferred pattern and app CIDRs?
lakegate-pm: pref per-AZ NAT for HA. app CIDRs are 10.60.0.0/16 and 10.61.0.0/24 across us-east-1a/b. provisioning NATs now.
Ibrahim N (Network): once NATs are up i'll add 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-0cafe to app RTs and open outbound 443 to our collector IPs. ETA ~25m.
Rae H (Security): KMS: their key policy only allows account IAM admins. they need to add our cross-account role. sample snippet sent:
```
{"Sid":"AllowRedwoodService","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/redwood-service"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:Encrypt"],"Resource":"*"}
```
Rae H (Security): also ask them to enable Key Grant tokens if they're using chained STS. otherwise decrypts may fail.
Ollie (Ops): i'll watch the forwarder and be ready to reload. if logs still don't show after egress, i'll tail and capture errors.
deploy-bot: change scheduled 6598765450: apply-nat-route-lakegate-app-rt (auto-approve).
Ibrahim N (Network): NAT routes applied at 6598765460. verified curl from app instance -> https://collector.redwood.ai/health returned 200.
lakegate-sre: updated KMS policy at 6598765468 and rotated Splunk HEC token earlier; sending token via vault now.
Ollie (Ops): forwarder reported `403 HEC token invalid` between 6598765464-6598765472. reloaded with new token at 6598765478; events resumed at 6598765479. ingestion gap ~7s (small window).
Rae H (Security): ran KMS decrypt test at 6598765475 - success. KMS signoff complete.
Tess R (CS): capture 7s ingestion gap for compliance note and offer replay if auditors need full continuity. marking renewal risk as "monitor" but will move to "watch" if anything else slips before Friday.
Ibrahim N (Network): runbook note: require CIDR + AZ mapping and preferred egress pattern at kickoff. i'll PR the onboarding checklist.
Rae H (Security): runbook note: include KMS policy snippet + a short test steps block (GenerateDataKey + Decrypt) so signoff is explicit.
Ollie (Ops): i'll add forwarder reload and token rotation checklist to Ops runbook and prepare replay playbook.
Tess R (CS): thanks team. i'll send LakeGate PM the remediation summary and offer a replay package for auditors. scheduling a 20m retro tomorrow to capture lessons learned. :white_check_mark:
